Trade Snow for Sun: Merida, Mexico (Jan 4 - 15, 2027)

Looking for an unforgettable way to spend Winter Break? Join our faculty-led trip to Merida, Mexico ( January 4 - 15, 2027 ), and immerse yourself in the language, culture, and everyday life of the Yucatan Peninsula. Program fee: $2,250 (includes housing, most meals, tours, transportation, and entrance fees) *Airfare not included. 
Enroll in SPAN 160/260/360/460 – Language & Culture in Yucatan (1 - 4 credits) during Fall 2026 , and travel with the class to Merida, Mexico over winter break in January 2027 for an immersive cultural and language experience. 

Interested? Contact Prof. Oscar Reynaga (reynagao@central.edu)

Out of the Darkness Walk

Please join us May 3rd in Maytag, 12pm support fair, 1:15pm Speakers, once the speakers are done then the walk will start. 
We’re hosting the Out of the Darkness Walk in partnership with The American Foundation for Suicide Prevention (AFSP), and it’s centered around raising awareness, breaking stigma, and reminding people that they are not alone. At a place like Central, it’s easy to feel like everyone has it together, but the reality is that there are people carrying things that we don’t know about. Whether it is stress, anxiety, loneliness, or deeper struggles, suicide prevention starts with creating a space where people feel seen, supported, and not alone. If you have any questions please email: carstensk2@central.edu
